notes: The Summer Youth Employment page lists it as one of the Michigan Works! Southeast summer programs. Jackson is west of Ann Arbor. Ask about dates and pay.
name: Jump-Start Jackson
what_you_do: Get paid on-the-job training with a local employer, a mentor, and lessons on soft skills like attendance, communication and managing money.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 24 who live in or go to school in Jackson County.
pay_detail: Paid on-the-job training; rate not stated
duration: Not stated on the page read
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page read.
how_to_apply: Use the Youth and Young Adult Application link on the Jump-Start Jackson page.
